notes.title: v1.1-75 3.7.2024
notes.notes:
v1.1-75 3.7.2024
-added "fast mode". fast mode makes runs roughly two times faster. every odd numbered wave is skipped, and instead you get more spell selections after waves.
from my testing it might be a bit harder than playing the classic mode, but I hope the balance isn't too bad and I think I enjoy the faster pacing of this new mode more -- let me know if you'd like to see it changed in some way

-missile spells should no longer spawn with the piercing variant. a piercing missile spell didn't pierce enemies, so it was misleading when a piercing missile spell spawned.

-updated godot to version 4.2.1, hopefully this shouldn't make anything worse.

notes.title: v1.0-73 21.12.2023
notes.notes:
v1.0-73
-added disable leaderboards checkbox in settings (when enabled leaderboards wont be updated with your scores and stats screen no longer shows your and your friends steam names)
-added infinite skips cheat checkbox in settings (when enabled your next run will have infinite spell skips)
